label: An agent gives esse insofar as it is a being in act
summary: Aquinas uses this premise and divine conservation to explain how inferior agents give being by divine power. The First Way treats an actual mover reducing a patient from potency to act. SCG III.66 explicitly applies the actuality condition to giving esse.
blocker: Giving esse in the chapter is an agent’s exercise of causal power. The route still requires every efficient CausesIn edge at esse, including any originating or sustaining edge in its domain, to count as such giving, and the giver’s being in act to be witnessed by its InAct in at least one modeled respect.
